title: Temperature-actuated, flow reduction valves for individual fixture fittings.
officialText:
Temperature-actuated, flow reduction devices,
where installed for individual fixture fittings, shall conform to ASSE 1062. Such valves shall not be used alone as a substitute for the
balanced pressure, thermostatic or combination shower valves required in Section 424.3.
